failures.title: mobile navigation keeps roadmap, glossary, and tags reachable

failure_follow_up.change: Wait for Pagefind first-query result up to 15 seconds; wait for route resources and closed/open menu viewport states. No product/output change.

unique_verification_accounting.note: 642 final-output functional cases (2 timing failures corrected by targeted runs) plus 10 unchanged-output performance cases. This is combined evidence, not a single clean 652-case run. Separate native-media fixture has 8 passed cases.

accessibility.limitations: Incomplete contrast checks include overlapping/gradient/pseudo-element backgrounds; React Flow Controls has aria-label on a div without a role. These are unautomated checks, not passed rules or a WCAG compliance guarantee.
accessibility.provenance: Latest 34 changed-route audits plus 426 unchanged-route audits from prior final-output run; no single 460-case rerun after the last 17-document review.

dense_link_prefetch.measurement: Chromium CDP encodedDataLength including response headers; incomplete requests are not assigned completed transfer bytes

static_diagram_scroll.measurement: 40 scroll steps after initial networkidle; PerformanceObserver longtask; zero maximum means no observed task >=50ms

chromium_native_fixture.delivery: Actual local HTTP 302 redirect to extensionless application/octet-stream MP3 with native HTMLMediaElement and Range responses; no mocked media APIs

csp_and_audio.webkit_javascript_disabled_diagram: passed in initial Windows WebKit run
csp_and_audio.limitations: Windows WebKit native media failure persisted without CSP; OS codec/backend cause is an inference, not established proof. Desktop engines do not prove physical iPhone/Safari behavior.
